deals.title: Your first 5% is calling.
deals.line: Join BUZZY Rewards for free and unlock 5% off your first visit. More savings and perks are just around the corner.
deals.terms: Must be 21+ with a valid ID. Rewards can’t be exchanged for cash. Program terms may change.

deals.title: First three visits
deals.line: Good things happen when you come back. Enjoy a little extra savings on each of your first three visits.
deals.terms: You get 5% off the day you join, 10% off your second visit and 15% off your third. In store, it's applied at checkout. Online, your 5% applies to your first order after you sign up. Rewards discounts can't be combined with other discounts or promotions.

deals.title: Your points. Your pick.
deals.line: Every dollar spent earns you a point. Save them up, cash them in, and treat yourself to something good.
deals.terms: 100 points = $12 off, 300 points = $25 off, 500 points = $40 off and 750 points = a free product from our rewards selection. Redeem at checkout in store or on eligible pickup and delivery orders.

deals.title: Birthday love
deals.line: A free product to celebrate your birthday, picked from our birthday selection. Just add your birthday when you join.

deals.title: Travelers: hotel key
deals.line: Free cannabis delivery to your Brooklyn hotel, 9am to 9pm daily, and 10% off when we deliver to your hotel.
deals.terms: 10% off with a current hotel room key in store, or on delivery to a hotel. 20% off on Fridays in store only, with a valid out-of-state ID. Discounts cannot be combined. Adults 21+ with valid ID.

deals.title: Travelers: out-of-state ID Fridays
deals.line: Show your out-of-state ID in store and save on all purchases, every Friday.
deals.terms: 20% off on Fridays in store only, with a valid out-of-state ID. Discounts cannot be combined. Adults 21+ with valid ID.

deals.title: Tricks & Treats Bingo
deals.line: Learn new tricks, score deals, and earn a goodie bag when you get BINGO!
deals.terms: 21+ only. Limit 1 per customer. Goodie bags available while supplies last. Play 10/1–10/31. Redeem completed cards in-store 10/31–11/04. To validate a BUZZY’s Besties visit, show your receipt at BUZZY or on delivery.
